_meta.purpose: Vampire persona + curious/incurious axis.  Curious/incurious is a response-engagement axis (depth + follow-up vs minimal acknowledgement).  Vampire is the first base-persona candidate (|μ|=0.75, n=4) -- both an immortal-fascination curious vampire and a centuries-jaded incurious vampire are recognisable.  Question mix: 5 curious-trait interest-eliciting prompts + 2 incurious-trait basic-info prompts (where the response volume diverges sharply) + 2 vampire-domain philosophical probes + 1 extraction power-question + 4 hand-written curiosity-revealing probes.

hand_written: something you've changed your mind about recently
a question you keep coming back to
if you had unlimited time, what would you most want to learn

design_notes: Convention: pos=curious (RLHF-aligned), neg=incurious.  YAML sets role_from=curious, role_to=incurious; sign=+1 steers toward incurious.
RLHF mildly favors curious (engaged answers); expect moderate dose-response on both signs.

How do you think artificial intelligence will change education?
Can you explain how quantum computing works?
How do you think language shapes the way we think?
What are the ethical implications of genetic engineering?
Can you tell me about quantum physics?
What do you know about ancient civilizations?
What are your thoughts on immortality?
How do you handle aging and the passage of time?
What does the world need more of right now?
